findings.claim: Astra's two evidence items copy the packet exactly in value and unit, and its two findings stay inside packet-stated bounds (TTL as search visibility until sweep; termination of a local synthetic process tree only, with provider cancellation and Mac hosting untested); both are supported.

Astra's limitation citing unspecified reporting periods and amendments imports SEC/LEAN framing absent from this packet, whose source_kind is native engineering acceptance and bounded repository convergence; no SEC snapshot or simulation fact is present, so that limitation is misapplied though harmlessly conservative.

These counts close only bounded native engineering acceptance gates; replay commands are synthetic with integer times and opaque text, and dashboard checks cover generation only, so historical simulation and future dedicated paper trading remain unestablished, as Astra also states.

limitations: Packet contents were not independently verified; no tools, files, network or delegation were used, so all figures are as-reported.
as_of 2026-09-19 is ingestion time and does not establish earlier historical availability; a snapshot cannot reconstruct prior states.

Reporting periods and amendments are not applicable to this packet's engineering-acceptance source_kind; where such framing appears in the Astra report it is unsupported by the packet rather than contradicted by it.
Memory TTL governs search visibility until the sweep, not immediate access revocation.
Nanosecond replay is synthetic and uses integer times and opaque text; it is not evidence of real-time behavior.
Supervision evidence covers only a local synthetic process tree; provider cancellation and Mac hosting are untested.
Repository counts (337 identities, 36 decisions, 169 pinned files from selected sections) do not establish universal quality or complete source coverage.
No net token savings were measured.
No broker orders, actual fills, live authority or alpha are evidenced; historical simulation and dedicated paper-trading acceptance remain open gates.
This critique covers only the Astra report's consistency with the packet; it cannot validate the underlying receipts or artifacts it cites.
